allowed_breakages.reason: Adds `RunInstructionSource` to the `InstructionSource` union; every existing member is unchanged.
Adds `RetryFeedbackPart` and the legacy retry translations to `ModelRequestPart`; the version policy permits new message parts, and every existing member is unchanged.
Adds input-support profile flags to `DEFAULT_PROFILE`; every existing key and value is unchanged.

False positive: `BackgroundTools` still inherits `prepare_tools` from `AbstractCapability` with the same signature. Griffe reports the removed override, not a removed method; the tool preparation moved into the wrapper toolset.
Adds the xAI Grok 4.6 and 4.7 Bedrock ids to `LatestBedrockModelNames`; every existing member is unchanged.

Not a compatibility impact: `HTTPX2TenacityTransport.wrapped` keeps its type, and an explicit `wrapped=` is used as before. Only the default inner transport changes, to one with Pydantic AI's connection pool limits (1000 connections, 100 kept alive) instead of HTTPX's 100/20, matching the clients Pydantic AI creates.
